items.title: Bottle Gourd on a Small Trellis
items.alt: A compact wooden A-frame trellis supports a climbing vine with two pale green bottle gourds, broad heart-shaped leaves and one open white flower.
items.description: A compact wooden A-frame trellis supports a climbing vine with two pale green bottle gourds, broad heart-shaped leaves and one open white flower. An original gourd illustration for personal designs and classroom seasonal activities.

items.title: Gourd Flower and Tendril
items.alt: A bottle-gourd vine segment has one open white five-lobed flower, a closed green bud, two heart-shaped leaves and a coiled tendril.
items.description: A bottle-gourd vine segment has one open white five-lobed flower, a closed green bud, two heart-shaped leaves and a coiled tendril. An original gourd illustration for personal designs and classroom seasonal activities.

items.title: Gourd Seedling with Roots
items.alt: A young gourd seedling with two oval cotyledons and one pointed true leaf grows above a small soil cutaway showing branching roots.

items.title: Germinating Gourd Seed
items.alt: A ridged pale tan gourd seed opens at one end around a curved white root and a short folded green shoot.

items.title: Opened Dry Gourd and Seeds
items.alt: An opened dry tan gourd reveals fibrous inner pith and pale flat seeds, with its removed stemmed lid and loose seeds beside it.

items.title: Partly Peeled Luffa Sponge
items.alt: A dry brown luffa fruit is partly peeled to reveal a pale fibrous sponge and dark seeds within its open end.
